name: Spacetime Gaussians (STG)
definition: A method where each Gaussian has a temporal opacity envelope (born/dies/peaks), a polynomial trajectory, and per-band spherical harmonics, allowing real-time rendering of any time slice.
summary: Spacetime Gaussians is a 4D Gaussian Splatting method that renders dynamic scenes in real-time using explicit polynomial trajectories and opacity envelopes, distinguishing itself from MLP-based deformation approaches.
